name: Cuisinart Elite Griddler | Williams Sonoma - Electric Indoor Grill - Cuisinart Indoor Griddle
description: Your secret weapon for busy weeknights, weekend lunches and impromptu gatherings, this next generation appliance from Cuisinart combines multiple cooking options in one high-performance package. A large grilling surface lets you cook efficiently for a crowd. Versatile machine has interchangeable nonstick cooking plates which allow grilling, griddling and pressing. Reversible, removable nonstick grill/griddle plates simplify cleaning and storage. Dual zone temperature control selector knob lets you heat the top plate, bottom plate or both, from warm to 450deg.F. Adjustable hinge has six preset widths to accommodate foods of varying thickness. 240" sq. grilling surface; 10" x 12" plate size. Sear function heats to 500deg.F for two minutes at a time. Grease drains into the integrated drip tray for healthier cooking and easier clean-up. Timer function plus auto shut-off after two hours. Brushed stainless steel housing with cast-aluminum cooking plates.. Comes with cleaning tool and instruction manual/recipe book. 15 3/4" x 14 3/4" x 8 1/2" high; 16 lb. 1800W. This product is intended for use in the United States and Canada and is built to United States electrical standards. A Williams Sonoma exclusive.
